Date: 2028-02-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Residency confirmation + SIG/CAIQ slices for EU-only deployment

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our compliance team has a few follow-ups before we move forward with the pilot in our EU region: primarily a residency attestation that production inference for our account will only run on EU-hosted nodes, a short CAIQ/SIG extract that maps to your private deployment controls, and a network diagram showing the VPC/private-peering topology and egress controls (we need names of the network owners and the peering order numbers).

Specific asks:
- Signed one-page residency letter on company letterhead (we can provide a template)
- Mapping table: CAIQ sections -> Redwood artifacts (SOC 2 control numbers, runbooks, keystore separation, KMS partitioning)
- A brief writeup on how Privatelink peering and egress are fenced (no transit outside EU; how we enforce routing)
- Evidence: SOC2 snapshot, peering order/ref, privatelink endpoint inventory

Can you send a consolidated package by EOD Feb 16? If that timeline is tight, propose alternatives and we'll align.

Best,
Alice
Alice Cho
Head of IT Risk, Veridian Health

Date: 2028-02-15T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Veridian evidence pack — scope and owners

Folks — I pulled the list and started assembling artifacts. Quick ownership and notes: 

- SOC2 snapshot (irene): include sections: CC6, CC7 (encryption/key mgmt), CC8 (access controls) and the auditor letter header only.
- CAIQ/SIG mapping (ben): use CAIQ v4 matrix, map answers to SOC2 control IDs and our runbook IDs. Keep responses concise; point to Drive links rather than embedding large attachments.
- Network & Privatelink matrix (kimberly): export endpoint inventory for EU region, include peering IDs and routing policy (+ owners). Also capture egress-blocking config for non-EU IPs.
- Residency letter (marissa/grace): draft attached; legal to sign.

A couple of clarifying questions for the external ask: when they say "no transit outside EU," do they require a technical attestation of routing enforcement (BGP/SG rules + egress ACLs) or a contractual guarantee? We should be explicit in the letter about the technical controls we operate and the fallback policy (we have automatic region-fallback only for failover, which we can turn off per-customer).

I started a Drive folder and uploaded the SOC2 redaction plan and a skeleton mapping. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Veridian-Residency-Pack

Irene
Director, Compliance

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-02-15T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Veridian evidence pack — scope and owners

Quick update — mapping is nearly done. A few technical bullets to include in the CAIQ slice:

- KMS partitioning: per-tenant key namespaces in the EU KMS cluster; HSM-backed keys for production tokens (artifact: kms-partitioning-runbook v2).
- KV/prefix caching: we never export KV cache to non-EU nodes; cache routing is gated by tenancy header and validated in the scheduler.
- Routing enforcement: privatelink endpoints in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 only, with outbound egress ACLs to deny non-EU destinations. We will attach the ACL snippet and the peering ticket references.
- Failover policy: by default region-fallback is disabled for account-level reservation; we can enable it only with signed opt-in.

I also exported the endpoint list to privatelink-network-matrix.xlsx and put a short note on where the peering IDs live in the procurement ticketing system.

Ben
Head of Infrastructure Ops

Grace/Irene/Team — this is great, thank you. A few clarifications before we accept the pack: 

- DocuSign is fine for the residency letter. Please route to legal@veridianhealth.com.
- For peering evidence we need either the provisioning order number or a screenshot from your ticketing system showing the peering was created and provisioned in the EU region.
- On routing enforcement: a short sample of the egress ACL plus your statement that region-fallback is account opt-in is sufficient. Please avoid operational runbook excerpts that contain internal hostnames; links are fine.

If you can send the final zipped pack and DocuSign request by end of day Feb 16 we will review and aim to return signed DocuSign by Feb 20. If something blocks delivery, propose an earlier call and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Alice
Head of IT Risk, Veridian Health
